crossRefs.note: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten…
He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him…
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before…

translations.web: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
translations.bsb: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
translations.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
translations.asv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
